Anna Hazare to begin hunger strike over RTI rule changes

Social activist Anna Hazare has announced he will begin a hunger strike on July 5 if the Maharashtra government does not revoke recent amendments to the Right to Information (RTI) rules. The amendments are the subject of his protest, with Hazare demanding their withdrawal. The planned strike highlights ongoing concerns about transparency and access to information in the state.
